cause: `.menu > button:not(.lbtn)` set `padding: 6px 10px`, which beat the `.ibtn` padding of 4px 8px, so icon triggers in a `.menu` were wider than the 32px icon button.
fix: The rule is now `.menu > button:not(.lbtn, .ibtn)`. One `:not()` list keeps the earlier specificity, so the compact and comfortable density rules still win. The 6px 10px padding of the other `.menu > button` triggers is unchanged.
method: Chromium, reduced motion, left to right at 390 (touch), 768, 1024 and 1440px and right to left at 390px (touch), by 900px. States: launchpad; invoice list, view, edit, create, compact view and comfortable view; customer list, view and edit; geography list and record; email; People record; the AI Assistant drawer. For each state the probe read every visible `.menu > button`, the box of every visible link, button and field, elements past the viewport edge, clipped elements and sideways scroll, then clicked each `.menu > button.ibtn` and read its list.

neighbours.widened: The top-bar app button and search field take up to 8px of the freed width.

menus.noListReason: Switch app opens the launchpad, not a list (75). At 390px the click order of this probe left Help closed (28); Help was checked on its own at 390px on 8 surfaces in both directions and opens at the same position before and after.
menus.moved: The System Alerts menu moved 4px with its bell at 768, 1024 and 1440px (36 readings).
menus.alreadyPastTheEdge: Invoice create, 390px right to left: More actions is 6.3px past the edge, before and after.

bellBadge: With a pointer the badge covers 10.2px of the bell icon width instead of 8.2px. On touch it is unchanged.
